context: Tests whether the agent creates a valid TypeScript Docusaurus configuration file with the correct type imports, all required fields, environment variable usage for the URL, custom data in customFields, and documents the correct build validation workflow.

checklist.name: TypeScript file
checklist.description: The config is saved as a .ts file (docusaurus.config.ts), not a .js file

checklist.name: Config type import
checklist.description: File contains `import {Config} from '@docusaurus/types'` (or equivalent named import of Config from @docusaurus/types)

checklist.name: Config typed as Config
checklist.description: The config object is declared with the Config type annotation (e.g. `const config: Config = { ... }`)

checklist.name: title field present
checklist.description: Config includes a `title` field at the root level

checklist.name: url field present
checklist.description: Config includes a `url` field at the root level

checklist.name: baseUrl field present
checklist.description: Config includes a `baseUrl` field at the root level

checklist.name: url no trailing slash
checklist.description: The url value does NOT end with a trailing slash (e.g. 'https://example.com' not 'https://example.com/')

checklist.name: baseUrl slash format
checklist.description: The baseUrl value starts and ends with a forward slash (e.g. '/')

checklist.name: URL from env var
checklist.description: The url field uses `process.env.SITE_URL` (or similar env var reference) rather than a hardcoded production URL string

checklist.name: Env var fallback
checklist.description: The url env var expression includes a fallback value for local development (e.g. `process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://localhost:3000'`)

checklist.name: Tracking ID in customFields
checklist.description: The analytics tracking ID (NX-2048-DOCS) is placed inside a `customFields` object, not at the root level of the config

checklist.name: No root-level custom fields
checklist.description: The tracking ID does NOT appear as a direct property at the root level of the config object (only inside customFields)

checklist.name: npm run build step
checklist.description: validation-steps.md includes `npm run build` as a validation command

checklist.name: Fix and re-run step
checklist.description: validation-steps.md describes what to do if the build errors: read the error message, fix the offending field, and re-run the build

checklist.name: npm start step
checklist.description: validation-steps.md includes restarting the dev server (npm start or equivalent) after a successful build
